verdict.rationale: Dover's own marketing says a job can be advertised to 50+ job boards, and its docs mention connecting job boards, so the core multi-board fan-out is a first-party capability. However, LinkedIn, Indeed and the aggregators are never named, and there is no evidence of sponsored-post management inside the ATS. Missing for 10: named LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator distribution, sponsored or paid post management from within the ATS, in-depth docs on how one posting syndicates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Advertise your job to 50+ job boards
